title: KATWALK VR WORKAROUND
summary: Hello all, If you are running Virtual Desktop + SteamVR + the Katwalk VR treadmill, you have probably tried a few things to stop the double vision in the mod. After a lot of effort, and even a full reinstall, I found that a background process for the ARMSTRAP overlay is the cause of the whole mess. Killing the process does not help on its own, because KATVR restarts it immediately. The workaround that worked for me was to move the process's ".exe" out of the gateway installation folder, then kill the process. With that, I was able to play in my current setup, treadmill and all. I hope this helps. I was really frustrated not being able to play with my setup and treadmill, so hopefully it saves someone the trouble. Have fun!
